lines.japanese: いや、めでたくねえよ。
lines.english: No, there was nothing happy about that.

lines.japanese: 「おい、大丈夫か山科さん」
lines.english: “Hey, you okay, Yamashina?”

lines.japanese: 俺たちは急ぎ駆けもどり、へたりこんでいた薄幸少女に呼びかけた。
lines.english: We hurried back and called to the unfortunate girl slumped on the ground.

lines.japanese: 「ごめん……平気、すぐ立てる……」
lines.english: “Sorry... I'm fine. I'll be able to stand in a minute...”

lines.japanese: 「無理しないでいいよ山科、ちょっと端っこ寄って休んでこ」
lines.english: “Don't push yourself, Yamashina. Let's move off to the side and rest.”

lines.japanese: 「そうだな、それがいい。どっこいしょ、っと」
lines.english: “Yeah, good idea. Heave-ho.”

lines.japanese: 俺は山科京の前に背を向けて屈みこんだ。
lines.english: I crouched with my back to Miyako Yamashina.

lines.japanese: 「さあ乗れ、山科さん。日本列島に夢を運ぶ超特急はねだ、しかし今日ばかりは君の貸切だ。女性専用車両だから痴漢の心配もいらな──」
lines.english: “Climb aboard, Yamashina. The Haneda Super Express carries dreams across the Japanese archipelago, but today it is reserved for you alone. And as this is a women-only car, there is no danger of molestation—”

lines.japanese: じょ、じょじょじょ女子を背負うということは、ひょっとしなくても身体的接触を伴うということで、つまりその、おんぶで臀部がふにんふにん……あ、あわわわ、これは合法的な痴漢行為じゃないか。
lines.english: C-c-carrying a girl on my back would necessarily involve physical contact. In other words, her bottom would be all soft and squishy against me... Oh, oh no. Was this legalized molestation?

lines.japanese: 俺の中の新たな人格・羽田狩男が形而上の鼻息を荒げていた。
lines.english: A new personality inside me—Randy Haneda—flared his metaphysical nostrils.

lines.japanese: 「え、なに？」
lines.english: “What is it?”

lines.japanese: 「あ、いや、なんでもないデスヨ？」
lines.english: “Oh, nothing at all?”

lines.japanese: 渡来明日香に不審がられたので、俺は顔を背けて平静を装った。
lines.english: Asuka Watarai looked at me suspiciously, so I turned aside and feigned composure.

lines.japanese: いや俺そんな、いやらしい気持ちとか全然ないけどね。班長として委員長として、純粋にクラスメイトの心配をしてるだけだからね。
lines.english: Not that I had any dirty thoughts. None whatsoever. As group leader and class representative, I was motivated purely by concern for a classmate.

lines.japanese: そう、今回クラスメイトがたまたま異性だったっていうだけで、そう、たまたま胸とか膨らんでる相手だったっていうだけで──
lines.english: Yes, that classmate merely happened to be of the opposite sex. She merely happened to be somebody with breasts—

lines.japanese: ──む、むむむ胸だとッ！？
lines.english: —b-b-breasts?!

lines.japanese: いやいや違う違う、落ちつけ狩男。
lines.english: No, no, wrong. Calm down, Randy.

lines.japanese: って誰が狩男っすか！
lines.english: Who’re you calling Randy?!

lines.japanese: あァん？　オメーしかいねえだろ。
lines.english: Huh? Who the fuck else could it be?

lines.japanese: ううん、そんなこと言ったって僕らはみんな僕なんだから、責任のなすりあいはよくないよ。
lines.english: Now, now. We're all me, so it isn't nice to shift the blame.

lines.japanese: ふぬん、ならば奈落の名に懸け、闘技をもって決着を付けようぞ。
lines.english: Hrnn. Then in the name of the abyss, let us settle this through combat.

lines.japanese: あーもー、おまいらケンカすんなてー。
lines.english: Aw, come on, you guys. Quit fightin'.

lines.japanese: 「ぱね田ー、何してんの早く来ーい」
lines.english: “Paneda! What are you doing? Hurry up!”
“Huh?”

lines.japanese: 呼ばれて我に返ると、山科京は渡来明日香に付きそわれてさっさと歩きだしていた。
lines.english: The call brought me back to myself. Miyako Yamashina was already walking off with Asuka Watarai at her side.

lines.japanese: 「お、おう、なんだ歩けるぐらいには回復してたのか。良かった良かった」
lines.english: “Oh. So you've recovered enough to walk. Good, good.”

lines.japanese: 「ン？　なんでおまえビミョーに落胆してんだ」
lines.english: “Hm? Why do you look kinda disappointed?”

lines.japanese: 「し、ししし、してませんよ落胆なんて！　失礼なこと言わないでちょうだいこの駄カラスが！」
lines.english: “I-I-I-I am not disappointed! Don't be insulting, you worthless crow!”

lines.japanese: 「どーせ王子様のキスで目覚めさせてあげよー、とか思ってたんじゃないの」
lines.english: “I bet you were planning to wake her with a kiss from Prince Charming.”

lines.japanese: 「おまえもうるさいですよこの駄プリンセス！」
lines.english: “Silence from you as well, worthless princess!”

lines.japanese: 「ふッ、そりゃあそんなメルヘン止まりじゃねえよなァ、陛下の妄想は」
lines.english: “Heh. His Majesty's fantasy wouldn't stop at some little fairy-tale kiss.”

lines.japanese: 「だ、だだだ黙れハリュー・クロード、陛下などと呼ぶでない」
lines.english: “S-s-silence, Claude Haryuu! Do not call me His Majesty!”

lines.japanese: 「ふふ……そうだよね……私なんかをそんな、ロマンスの対象として据えるひとはいないよね……」
lines.english: “Hee-hee... You're right... Nobody would ever see somebody like me as a romantic prospect...”

lines.japanese: 「うるさい山科、おまえも息を乱してまでジョークかますな。元気そうで何よりじゃねえか、ブッ殺すぞコノヤロウ。余の情熱的な接吻を披露できず無念であるわ、もはははは──」
lines.english: “Shut up, Yamashina. Don't throw yourself out of breath making jokes too. I'm glad you're feeling better. I'll fucking kill you, asshole. 'Tis a pity I cannot display my passionate kiss. Mohahahaha—”

lines.japanese: ──って、うそおおお！？　なに口走ってんの俺ェ！
lines.english: —Wait, whaaaaat?! What was I saying?!

lines.japanese: 六つの白い視線が俺に注がれていた。
lines.english: Three pairs of eyes fixed me with cold stares.

lines.japanese: 「い、いや、接吻できず無念というのはですね、決して不埒な意味合いで申しあげたわけではなくですね」
lines.english: “U-um, when I expressed regret at my inability to kiss you, I certainly did not intend any improper implication.”

lines.japanese: 俺はとりあえず言い訳したが、いかにもしどろもどろで、なおさら怪しいひと感まる出しだった。
lines.english: I tried to explain, but my stumbling words only made me sound more suspicious.

lines.japanese: ああ、いかん。精神的に追いこまれると仮統合にほころびが出て、望まない言動が漏れでてしまう。
lines.english: This was bad. When I was under emotional pressure, the seams of our provisional integration came apart and unwanted words and actions leaked through.

lines.japanese: やはりあのとき、自らの過去にきちんと向かいあうべきだったのかもしれない。
lines.english: Maybe I really should have faced my past properly back then.

lines.japanese: クリスマス直前ごろ、俺たちは自分探しの旅に出るか否かの選択を迫られた──
lines.english: Shortly before Christmas, we had been confronted with a choice: whether to embark on a journey of self-discovery—

lines.japanese: ──のだが、なんやかんやで先延ばしにしてしまい、いまに至る。
lines.english: —but one thing led to another, we put it off, and here we were.

lines.japanese: ああ、あのとき故郷の街で、俺たちの過去に立ちむかっていれば──
lines.english: If I had confronted our past in our hometown that day—

lines.japanese: ──いれば、あるいは小鳩と恋人のように過ごしている現在だってあったのかもしれない。
lines.english: —then perhaps I might now be spending my days with Kobato as her lover.

lines.japanese: 「あの……ぱね田くん？」
lines.english: “Um... Paneda?”

lines.japanese: 「いまダダ滑りしてるんだけど、どーしてくれんのこの空気」
lines.english: “That joke bombed so hard it killed the whole mood. What're you going to do about it?”
“Wh-what...?”

lines.japanese: なんと。いまの伽楼羅的なセクハラ発言は、単なる寒いギャグとして受けながされたのか。さすが俺、日ごろしょーもない三流芸人キャラを定着させてきた甲斐があったぜ。
lines.english: Incredible. They had dismissed my Karura-style sexual harassment as nothing but a lousy joke. I had to hand it to myself. All my time establishing a persona as a third-rate comedian had paid off.

lines.japanese: よし、ならばこのままネタをネタとして貫きとおそう。
lines.english: Excellent. Then I would commit to the joke and see it through.

lines.japanese: 「だまれ愚民、俺は接吻がしたいんだ。はー接吻してぇー、ちょお接吻してぇー」
lines.english: “Silence, commoners! I want a kiss. God, I want to kiss somebody. I really, really want a kiss.”

lines.japanese: 「というわけで山科さん、ロマンスあふれる王子様のキッスで心地よく目覚めてみないかね」
lines.english: “So, Yamashina, would you care to awaken blissfully beneath a romantic kiss from Prince Charming?”

lines.japanese: 「もう目覚めてるから気持ちだけでいいよ」
lines.english: “I'm already awake, so the thought is enough.”

lines.japanese: 「ははは、山科さんは貞淑だなあ。じゃー、まー仕方ないから、おいそこのビッチ、おまえで我慢してやるからとりあえず気でも失え」
lines.english: “Ha-ha-ha. What a chaste maiden you are. Well, I suppose it can't be helped. Hey, bitch, I'll settle for you, so lose consciousness for a moment.”

lines.japanese: 「おまえが失え」
lines.english: “You lose consciousness.”

lines.japanese: 渡来明日香はプリンセスだてらにツッコミが手厳しかった。
lines.english: For a princess, Asuka Watarai delivered a merciless retort.

lines.japanese: 「ぶはん、生意気なわっぱめ。おいレイヴンよ、この無礼な女をやってしまえ」
lines.english: “Bahun! Impudent whelp. Raven, dispose of this insolent woman.”

lines.japanese: 俺は増援を呼んだ。
lines.english: I called for reinforcements.

lines.japanese: 「御意」
lines.english: “As you command.”

lines.japanese: 冷眼の殺戮者は、意外や逆らわなかった。アスカ姫の前に立ちはだかる黒衣の影が、陽炎のように揺らめいた。
lines.english: To my surprise, the cold-eyed killer did not resist. The shadow in black that barred Princess Asuka's path shimmered like a heat haze.

lines.japanese: 「国王陛下の頼みとあっちゃ断れないねェ……」
lines.english: “Can't exactly refuse a request from His Majesty...”

lines.japanese: 「明日香、おまえ旦那と子供どっちが大事だ」
lines.english: “Asuka, which is more important to you: your husband or your child?”

lines.japanese: 「自分」
lines.english: “Me.”

lines.japanese: 即答だった。
lines.english: The answer was immediate.

lines.japanese: 「げらげらげら！　ひでえ答えだなァ明日香、やっぱおまえはロックだ。いや、むしろパンクだな」
lines.english: “Geh-ha-ha-ha! That's a terrible answer, Asuka. You really are rock and roll. No, you're punk.”

lines.japanese: レイヴンは手を叩いて喜んだのち、俺に振りかえって白い歯を覗かせた。
lines.english: Raven clapped in delight, then turned to me and flashed his white teeth.

lines.japanese: 「羽田、今日のところはおまえの負けだ」
lines.english: “Haneda, you lose this round.”

lines.japanese: 「へ？　あ、はあ、そうですか」
lines.english: “Huh? Oh. I see.”

lines.japanese: よく分からないが俺は敗北したらしい。
lines.english: I did not quite understand, but apparently I had been defeated.

lines.japanese: こうして身持ちの堅い娘たちの貞操は無事守られましたとさ。めでたしめでたし。
lines.english: And so the chastity of every virtuous maiden was safely preserved. And they all lived happily ever after.
